newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritian rupee firms vs dollar, weakens vs stg.
newsitem.headline: Mauritian rupee firms vs dollar, weakens vs stg.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against the dollar and weakened against sterling on Wednesday, reflecting international trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at commercial mean rates of 20.5865 rupees to the dollar, from 20.6045 on Tuesday, and of 33.6925 to sterling, from 33.404 on Tuesday.
Forex dealers said the rupee's fixing on Wednesday was done in line with the dollar's weakening and the sterling's strong surge in overnight international foreign exchange markets.
They added that the local market was square as the central bank sold dollars in the interbank market during an intervention in mid-afternoon Tuesday at the prevailing interbank rate.
